jobs.occupation: Logistics Employee by Royal FloraHolland in Aalsmeer  (10-23 hours per week) (publications-51557-B)
jobs.description:
Are you a morning bird and you love having your afternoons free? Then this is the perfect job for you! Start your day surrounded by the scent of fresh flowers. As an order picker at Royal FloraHolland in Aalsmeer, you make a difference every morning. You’ll work with a large, friendly team and make sure flowers and plants get to the right customer on time. Your shift starts at 6:00 AM, so you can enjoy your free afternoons after your work. Ideal if you enjoy active work and having your afternoons open!Every day is different. You pick up your cart full of flowers and distribute them to the carts of customers. You use a headset to hear exactly where your flowers need to go. You smoothly drive an electric cart through the logistics hall. No license required, we teach you everything you need to know. You lift beautiful plants and flowers from your cart to the customer’s cart. You also check orders and help with other logistics tasks. You work in a nice flow and see the results of your work immediately.Do you want to be active, see results quickly, and work in an enthusiastic team? Join us! You do not need work experience, just motivation and a positive attitude. Apply now and brighten not only your day, but also someone else’s! 🌸

We are looking for you if;

- You are at least 18 years old;

- You are fit and able to lift flower carts;

- You are at least 1.65 meters tall because of safety reasons
- You can start at 6:00 AM in Aalsmeer

- You are available at least 2 weekday mornings per week

- You can work for at least 7 months

- You speak good Dutch or English

- You can provide a certificate of good conduct (we pay for it)
- 
If you do not have a certificate of good conduct yet, you can request one (we will help you with this)

- You live within 30 km of Aalsmeer

- You are collegial, involved, and work accurately.

Do you want to earn a good salary and choose your working days? Then get started at Kuehne Nagel in Maarssen. They are open both during the week and in the weekend. - Earn € 14,99 per hour excl. allowances

- Varied job!

Who you are
As a production employee at Kuehne Nagel, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You are willing to work in two shifts: 6:00-15:00 and 14:45 – 23:45
- You are available at least 3 days a week from Monday to Sunday. You choose!
- You speak Dutch or English
- You can work in Maarssen
- Please note that a VOG screening is part of your application process

What will you do
If you start working as a production employee at Kuehne Nagel, you will have a varied job. You will process the returns from Albert Heijn. One moment you are busy with the packaging of empty crates and bottles and you make sure that they are sorted and placed in the right place. The next moment you as a production employee are processing the returned food (that could no longer be sold). You make sure that the products are neatly separated. Another moment you may help unload the trucks with the products. Then you take them to the right place in the warehouse. Your work is very diverse!

Where will you work
Kuehne Nagel in Utrecht has three locations. You will work as a production employee in the distribution center in Maarssen. This is where all returned products from Albert Heijn that can no longer be sold end up. You will work in an international team with enthusiastic colleagues. There is an informal working atmosphere.
